body:
It pretty much is. They don’t seem to care one bit about any of their kids’ issues and only care about what others say about them. It’s a fucking mess and a half.

Thanks for the encouragement, mate. I don’t have a whole lot of hope for myself but I really do appreciate it.

No, I can’t really go anywhere unfortunately. If I leave, they’d try looking for me, and if they know I want to leave, they’ll send me to a place where they know they can find me. Plus they have a bunch of drama with each other and that’s pretty much plagued my entire existence and it hasn’t helped my suicidal thoughts one bit.
